name: V4 Bambu PETG Translucent + PLA Translucent, P2S 0.6 HF
confirmation: User confirmed 0.6 mm High Flow, PETG AMS slot 4, PLA AMS slot 2 on 2026-09-13.
colour_source: Bambu Studio's selected translucent material colours; display colours do not bind AMS slots.
flush_source: Bambu Studio's selected PETG Translucent / PLA Translucent project, each direction above the shared 280 mm3 material minimum.
exceptions: Resolve complete installed translucent filament presets instead of the Tinmorry/PLA Basic recipes. Keep nozzle variant columns, original geometry and shared role/support policies.
Retain the selected translucent colour purge matrix: 298 mm3 PETG to PLA; 575 mm3 PLA to PETG. No flushing into model, infill or supports.

Shared-bed override: set PLA's textured plate settings to the PETG model's 70 C for both first and other layers. The body slice emitted 55 C during an early material change even with by_first_filament. Verify actual bed commands remain 70 C until shutdown. All nozzle, flow, cooling and retraction settings retain the native translucent recipes.
Use Bambu's explicit allow-mix-temp CLI option for the intentional PETG/PLA support pair. Neither material is relabelled or assigned a false support-material identity.

Body surface exception: Classic with thin-wall detection and outer-first ordering removes the measured 0.52-to-1.09 mm exterior bead-width variation at the D6 covers. Precise outer wall is disabled because Bambu ignores it for outer-first ordering. Qualify complete exterior coverage, D6 retaining continuity and insertion timing from the final slice. Caps and wings retain their existing Arachne process.

AMS slots are print-send mappings. Native filament_map/nozzle_map vectors identify the single physical nozzle, not AMS slots. Bind material 1 to slot 4 and material 2 to slot 2 in Bambu Studio's Send dialog.
